title: The 3 Best Jogging Strollers
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for jogging strollers, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at jogging strollers using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: BOB Gear Revolution Flex 3.0 Jogging Stroller
products.blurb: Key specs: Swivel-locking front wheel, Mountain-bike-style suspension with air-filled tires, Adjustable handlebar.
strengths: Suspension and air-filled tires produce a noticeably smoother ride than crossover joggers on trail or uneven pavement
Swivel-locking front wheel gives true running stability when locked and everyday maneuverability when unlocked
Adjustable handlebar fits a wide range of parent heights, useful when both parents run with it
6 storage pockets are a real convenience on longer runs
limitations: Larger folded footprint than everyday strollers, less ideal for small trunks
Air-filled tires can go flat and need occasional inflation, unlike foam-filled alternatives
features: 6 storage pockets including a cell phone pocket

products.name: Thule Urban Glide 2 Jogging Stroller
products.blurb: Key specs: 16-inch rear wheels with suspension, 5-point padded safety harness, Multi-position, ventilated canopy.
strengths: Large 16-inch rear wheels smooth out cracks and curbs better than smaller-wheeled everyday strollers
Quick-release rear wheels make it genuinely more compact for trunk storage than most joggers
75 lb capacity means it stays usable well past toddler stage
Balances running-stroller stability with everyday city maneuverability better than bulkier joggers
limitations: No storage-focused accessories included, like a cell phone pocket, out of the box
Front wheel swivel-lock mechanism takes a bit of practice to engage quickly
features: Quick-release rear wheels for compact storage

products.name: Graco FastAction Fold Jogger Stroller
products.blurb: Key specs: One-second, one-hand FastAction fold, Lockable front swivel wheels, Click Connect infant car seat compatibility.
strengths: Front wheel lock gives basic running stability for light jogging
Click Connect compatibility means it can double as a newborn travel system
One-hand fold is fast for everyday errands, not just running
limitations: Wheels and suspension are noticeably more basic than the BOB or Thule for sustained running
Not intended for serious trail running or high-mileage use
Heavier and less agile than dedicated three-wheel joggers at running speed
features: Click Connect infant car seat compatibility
Deluxe padded seat with multi-position recline

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
